lines: Pitts' usage has ticked up lately. He played 66% of snaps over the last 3 games versus 61% for the season, and he averaged 5.0 targets versus 4.2.
The points haven't followed. He's at 5.0 PPR points per game over the last 3, down from 7.8 for the season, with 26.3 receiving yards per game.
ATL has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said Pitts' production is not where the team wants it, but he won't single him out.
